Nearmiss.title: Near-Miss Detection via Camera–LiDAR Depth Fusion
Nearmiss.blurb: Monocular cameras estimate depth cheaply but with systematic bias; LiDAR is accurate but sparse. Training against LiDAR point clouds as ground truth corrects the camera's systematic error and cut depth RMSE by 80% in urban scenes, with the whole inference path running on the scooter's onboard compute where a near-miss has to be called in milliseconds rather than offline.

UTSAFindMySpot.title: UTSAFindMySpot
UTSAFindMySpot.blurb: Parking management system reading live CCTV footage at 10 FPS — per-bay ROI extraction, YOLO11 detection, and a Laravel dashboard surfacing real-time occupancy to students. A pretrained YOLO11 fine-tuned on 1,000+ annotated lot images reaches 90% detection accuracy; denoising and contrast normalization cut false positives by 90%.

FairLane.title: FairLane
FairLane.blurb: Fair-lending co-pilot that audits its own credit decisions for demographic bias, replaying each application across demographic variants before a human signs off.

CityShield.title: CityShield
CityShield.blurb: Situational awareness agent for large public events, fusing crowd density, traffic flow, and public sentiment into a single crowd-crush risk signal.
